# 🐞 Bug report ### Command (mark with an `x`) - [ ] new - [ ] build - [ ] serve - [ ] test - [ ] e2e - [ ] generate - [ ] add - [ ] update - [ ] lint - [X] xi18n - [ ] run - [ ] config - [ ] help - [ ] version - [ ] doc ### Is this a regression? the `ng i18n`command extracts message correctly. ### Description I'm trying to use `ng xi18n --ivy` command with Angular 10.1.5 / CLI 10.1.5 packages to extract all my Typescript and HTML text for translation. ## I'm submitting a... 

[ ] Regression (a behavior that used to work and stopped working in a new release)
[x] Bug report  
[ ] Performance issue
[ ] Feature request
[ ] Documentation issue or request
[ ] Support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
[ ] Other... Please describe:
## Current behavior XMB and XLIFF(1,2) print the wrong source line for a message in an inline template, [example in repo tests](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/c8ad9657c9423cc2d07d6cc6a230ef28e2b60f3c/packages/compiler-cli/test/extract_i18n_spec.ts#L47): ```html src/comp2.ts:2,3 ``` 1. The compiler reads `@Component` and sets the value for `template` or `templateUrl`. 2. Then it normalizes things like this: ```js // not normalized { "template": "" } { "templateUrl": "foo.html" } // normalized { "template": "", templateUrl: "foo.ts" } { "templateUrl": "foo.html", template: "
bar
" } ``` 3. The compiler sends the value of `template` to an HTML compiler and gets back an AST. 4. The i18n extractor determines the position of the messages given the html AST. ## Expected behavior The generated code should have been: ```html src/comp2.ts:8,9 ``` 1. The compiler should store a value (e.g. `templateOffsetRows`) pointing to where in the TS file can the template be found. 2. Same behavior 3. Same behavior 4. Same as before, but the row/line numbers are incremented by `templateOffsetRows`. ## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions bazel test //packages/compiler-cli/test:extract_i18n ## What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior? This is a follow up for issue #24884, tools that rely on the correctness of the output will be.. incorrect. This is IMO less important than the other bug because I expect most people to use html templates instead of inline templates in production. There are exceptions like tiny components, but in most cases those tiny components don't really have any messages to be translated. This is ofc on my experience. ## Environment Commit: c8ad9657

body:
OK, so I did some debugging and this issue is caused by us skipping "leading trivia characters" thanks to this https://github.com/angular/angular/commit/304a12f0271a08c447c1d1c12fa7dd99baf1f983.

The problem appears because the i18n message begins with a leading space, which is skipped when computing the source-span for the start of the i18n message. This appears to make the source-spans for the inner pieces out of sync.

Actually things are more complex than just that, although that is part of it... 
It seems that there are various places where we are mapping back and forth between source-spans and parsed content, which is causing some source-spans to get out of sync.
I think this needs some considerable thought...

I made some tests with last Angular 11 and I always have bad translation:

```xml
    <unit id="MAD.confirmDeleteModalMsg">
      <notes>
        <note category="location">src/app/components/setup/zone/detail/zone-detail.component.html:14,16</note>
        <note category="location">src/app/components/setup/wall/panel-setup/panel-setup.component.html:56,58</note>
        <note category="location">src/app/components/setup/vc/setup-panel/vc-setup-panel.component.html:10,12</note>
        <note category="location">src/app/components/setup/ps/setup-panel/ps-setup-panel.component.html:7,9</note>
      </notes>
      <segment>
        <source> Confirm delete <ph id="0" equiv="INTERPOLATION" disp="e {{uiName"/>?
</source>
      </segment>
    </unit>
```

for the original text to translate:

```html
<mad-modal-confirm i18n="@@MAD.confirmDeleteModalMsg" i18n-title="@@psSetupPanel.modalConfirmTitle" title="Delete Power Supply" size="md" id="deletePowerSupplyButton" (closed)="deletePowerSupplyConfirm($event)">
  Confirm delete {{uiName}}?
</mad-modal-confirm>
```

I'm really disappointed because I like the new Angular 11 version but I cannot migrate my project with this show stopper.

For me it's not corrected and I don't understand why this issue was closed.
